tests.name: TestTheWindowHasOneOwner
tests.reason: The test reads transfer.go from its runtime working directory. Its 5605 binary ran after shared transfer.go had changed to the 538 source, so the old source-inspection ownership table and runtime source did not match.
tests.interpretation: Preserved as a terminal test failure, but it is not evidence that the immutable 5605 binary violated its compiled ownership contract.

tests.name: TestTheWindowRuleIsInertOnAShortPath
tests.interpretation: This result is independent of the runtime source-inspection mismatch and remains a preserved baseline regression failure.

redaction: This classification retains test outcomes, numerical measurements, source hashes, and the raw-log hash only. The raw log, source files, overlays, and binary are outside the archive.
